reasons.plausibility: Introducing nanoscale ordered precipitates to enhance coercivity in FeCoNi is scientifically credible, though controlling precipitation to form an L1₀-like phase may present moderate technical challenges.
reasons.testability: The proposal includes a clear experimental design (comparison of annealed vs. control samples using TEM, XRD, and magnetometry) that can decisively confirm or refute the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: Identifying a potential route to enhance coercivity in fcc FeCoNi while retaining high saturation magnetization is strategically valuable for researchers seeking to improve magnetic properties of high-entropy alloys.
